comment: Initial load counts the app entry and every transitive static JavaScript import, plus CSS. Lazy counts chunks only reached by dynamic imports (the terminal). The previous check counted static shared chunks as lazy and missed them from initial, so these caps were corrected to match the built asset graph. Sizes are bytes; gzip level 9 approximates a compressing proxy. The UX status skeleton adds under 200 raw bytes and reduced the latest five-run Pixel 4 CLS max from 0.409 to 0.000. The password-reset hint, notice and forced password change (PRD-036) raised the initial JavaScript caps from 90000 raw / 31000 gzip to 91000 / 31750; measurements are in DECISIONS.md D17.
